enforcement_model.structural_scope: The two validators independently plant 33 policy-shape mutations that are meaningful before producer output exists. Each planted mutation must produce at least one issue, and both clean validators must exit 0.
enforcement_model.semantic_scope: After a producer, commercial evaluator, B0 crosswalk or executable exists, the independent reviewer applies every NC-01..NC-44 control to the corresponding real artifact/evidence class. A control that cannot yet be instantiated remains UNEXECUTED and blocks the affected later claim; it is never pre-counted as pass.
enforcement_model.no_count_inflation: The 44 frozen policy controls are not reported as 44 executed tests before their target artifacts exist. Prelaunch reports exactly 33/33 structural mutations and 44/44 controls frozen.

clean_baseline_expected: Both structural validators exit 0 before launch and report exactly 33/33 self-test mutations.
future_mutation_expected: When a target artifact exists, its applicable control mutation must produce a nonzero verdict; missing execution remains blocking rather than pass.
